mechanism: NSAIDs may reduce the efficacy of oral contraceptives through inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis and potential effects on enterohepatic circulation, while estrogens may increase NSAID levels by inhibiting their renal clearance and glucuronidation.
action: Counsel patients on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy; consider backup contraception during NSAID use and for 7 days after discontinuation, or use alternative analgesia.
